bucky.tag: From best friend to weapon to redemption
bucky.intro: No MCU character has a longer arc: in 1943 Bucky falls from the train — and in 2026 stands against Doom as a New Avenger. In between: brainwashing, guilt and the slowest healing process in the franchise.
notes: The best friend: Bucky falls — seemingly to his death.
The twist: Hydra's Winter Soldier is Bucky. 'Who the hell is Bucky?'
The tape: Zemo activates him, the Avengers break over him.
The therapy: amends list, Wakandan acquittal, peace with himself.
The new family: congressman, then New Avenger.
The proving ground: 80 years of experience against Doom.

wanda.tag: From victim to threat — and back?
wanda.intro: Perhaps the most consistent tragedy in the MCU: every station takes something from Wanda — parents, brother, Vision, her children, finally herself. And every station makes her more powerful.
notes: The beginning: experiments, Ultron, Pietro's death.
Lagos: the world learns to fear her.
The impossible: she destroys Vision — and Thanos turns back time.
The Hex: grief creates a family that never existed.
The fall: the Darkhold turns grief into a crusade.
The legacy: Billy lives. Wanda's story is not over.

steine.n: The Path of the Infinity Stones
steine.tag: Six stones, eleven years, one snap
steine.intro: The clockwork behind the Infinity Saga: each stone was introduced individually, long before Thanos struck. The path to trace it — or look it up in the artifacts entry.
notes: Space Stone: the Tesseract in Red Skull's hands.
Mind Stone: Loki's scepter — a gift from Thanos.
Reality Stone: the Aether, handed to the Collector.
Power Stone: the Orb of Morag.
Time Stone: the Eye of Agamotto.
Soul Stone & all the rest: Thanos collects. Snap.
The Time Heist: all six, once more — and Tony's price.

multiversum.tag: From the first crack to Doomsday
multiversum.intro: The causal chain of the Multiverse Saga in seven steps — understand this and you are ready for December 18.
notes: The door: time travel proves timelines are negotiable.
The dam breaks: Sylvie kills He Who Remains. Everything branches.
The first crossover: foreign universes invade New York.
The vocabulary: incursions — worlds can collide.
The hold: Loki becomes the tree that carries everything.
The bridge: anchor beings, the Void, the Fox legacy connected.
The reckoning: Doom steps into a multiverse ripe for the storm.

spidey.intro: Three universes, three Peters, one rule: with great power comes great responsibility — and great suffering. The path through 24 years of spider cinema up to the current fresh start.
notes: Earth-96283: the bite, Uncle Ben, the first swing.
The peak: Doc Ock and the train scene — the genre reference to this day.
Earth-120703: the reboot with Garfield and Gwen.
The fall: Gwen's death breaks Peter — and the franchise.
Earth-616: 'Hey everyone' — Holland enters the MCU.
The union: three Peters, one therapy session with fists.
The fresh start: forgotten, alone, friendly — in theaters since 07/31.

youngav.intro: For years Marvel has been quietly building a junior team — figure by figure, series by series. Officially it doesn't exist. Look closely and it is almost complete.
notes: The seed: Cassie grows up five years without her father in the Blip.
Kate Bishop: better archer, more chaotic energy.
Kamala Khan: the fan who becomes a hero — first mutant.
America Chavez: the girl who walks between worlds.
Cassie Lang: her own suit, first battle, Kang experience.
Wiccan: Wanda's son, reality mage.
The starting gun: Kamala recruits Kate — 'Avengers assemble' energy.

shield.tag: The agency that started it all — and was Hydra
shield.intro: Before there were Avengers, there was the organization that gathered them. Its 2014 collapse is still the best twist in the MCU — and its ghost haunts every spy story since.
notes: The origin: Peggy Carter and the SSR at war with Hydra.
First contact: Coulson waits patiently in the hallway, Fury in the credits.
The peak: Helicarrier, Avengers Initiative, Coulson's sacrifice.
The collapse: 'Hail Hydra' — the enemy had been in the house since 1945.
The ghosts: Fury alone against infiltration, this time by Skrulls.
The after: Fury runs S.A.B.E.R. in orbit — S.H.I.E.L.D. is history.

thanosweg.tag: Six years of build-up, two gauntlets, one grin
thanosweg.intro: No villain was ever built up more patiently: a grin in the credits in 2012, the Snap in 2018. The benchmark Doom is now measured against — and the blueprint for how Marvel tells final bosses.
notes: The grin: 'To challenge them would be to court death.'
The first appearance: on the throne, still outsourced to Ronan.
The Titan does it himself: 'Fine, I'll do it myself.'
The victory: he sacrifices Gamora, beats everyone — and rests.
Dust twice: beheaded at the cabin, snapped away in the battle.

magie.intro: For a long time the MCU was tech country — then came Strange, and with him chaos magic, dark books, witches' roads and finally the devil himself. Against Doom, the sorcerer-scientist, this strand is suddenly central.
notes: The basics: Kamar-Taj, the astral plane, the Time Stone.
Chaos magic: Wanda creates reality out of grief.
The spell: a botched incantation opens the multiverse.
Escalation: Darkhold, dreamwalking, incursions.
The Witches' Road: Agatha, Billy and the cost of magic.
The devil: Mephisto makes his first deal.

wakandaweg.tag: From hidden kingdom to world power
wakandaweg.intro: Wakanda stepped out of the shadows, lost two kings and found a rival beneath the sea. In Doomsday its vibranium is one of the prizes being fought over.
notes: The loss: King T'Chaka dies in Vienna, T'Challa hunts Bucky.
The opening: Wakanda shows itself to the world — and survives Killmonger.
The battlefield: 'Wakanda forever!' against Thanos' hordes.
The grief: T'Challa's death, Namor's war, Shuri's mantle.
The history: centuries of Wakandan warriors in retrospect.
The future: Shuri, M'Baku — and a new Black Panther?

deadpoolweg.tag: From sewn-shut mouth to Marvel Jesus
deadpoolweg.intro: No character has a more absurd career path: burned as a mute Frankenstein in 2009, made perfect out of spite in 2016, savior of two franchises in 2024. Meta cinema in four acts plus one bereavement.
notes: The original sin: Deadpool without a mouth. Reynolds never forgets.
The revenge: leaked footage forces the film that gets everything right.
The family: X-Force dies, the heart grows.
The sting: the death that later drives Wade — Logan's end is his trauma.
The redemption: anchor being, the Void, 'Marvel Jesus' — and a Wolverine who stays.

kangweg.n: Kang: Story of a Failed Villain
kangweg.tag: The saga endgame that never was
kangweg.intro: A lesson in real time: Marvel spent three years building a final boss, lost his actor — and replaced him with something bigger. This path is cinema history AND making-of at once.
notes: The beginning: He Who Remains explains the Multiversal War — and dies.
The theatrical debut: Kang the Conqueror loses to ants. Not a good start.
All his lives: Victor Timely, the Temporal Loom — Loki's sacrifice depowers him on the side.
The legacy: the Council of Kangs still waits — and Doom takes the seat.

hulkweg.tag: From monster to Smart Hulk to father
hulkweg.intro: Three actor attempts, no second solo film (Universal rights!), and still one of the most complete arcs in the MCU — told entirely in other people's films.
notes: The fugitive: Norton-Banner against Ross and Abomination.
The breakthrough: 'That's my secret — I'm always angry.'
The exile: two years as only Hulk, gladiator on Sakaar.
The fusion: Smart Hulk — and the Blip snap that cost his arm.
The mentor: Jen inherits his blood, he shows her the basics.
The father: Skaar is here — and Hulk tears up Peter's streets.

furyweg.tag: The man who gathered the heroes
furyweg.intro: He has no super serum and no armor — only foresight and distrust. No Fury, no Avengers: the path of the greatest string-puller, from the Cold War to the space station.
notes: 1995: a Skrull war, a Flerken, a lost eye, an idea.
2008: 'You've become part of a bigger universe' — the Initiative begins.
2012: his life's work assembles — against the Council's will.
2014: his own apparatus was Hydra. Fury dies (officially).
2025: tired, alone, paranoid — the Skrull war catches up with him.
2026: S.A.B.E.R. in orbit — Fury now watches from above.

weltlage.n: The State of the World Before Doomsday
weltlage.tag: Why Earth is so vulnerable in 2026
weltlage.intro: Doom is not attacking a strong world — he is attacking THIS one: no standing Avengers team, a toppled president, disputed naming rights, an unstable Sentry. The chain of weakening, film by film.
notes: The gap: Tony dead, Steve old, Natasha gone — nobody fills the vacuum.
The chaos: Blip returnees, refugee crises, a failed Cap.
The wound: New York experiences the multiverse — and forgets its hero.
The scandal: the President becomes the Red Hulk, the adamantium race begins.
The Void Day: half of New York swallowed — the 'New Avengers' are PR.
The reckoning: a storm-ripe planet meets a god with a plan.

symbionten.tag: From the black suit to the sleeping god
symbionten.intro: Sony's stickiest storyline: three Venoms, a forced beginning, a meme detour — and a drop that is still lying on a bar counter in Earth-616.
notes: The forced beginning: the studio wanted Venom, Raimi didn't. You could tell.
The reboot: Eddie and his hungry roommate — critics horrified, box office full.
The escalation: Carnage — and the leap into the MCU in the credits.
The drop: Eddie travels back, a piece of symbiote stays in Earth-616.
The end: farewell to Eddie — and Knull opens his eyes. Unresolved.

games.spiderman-ps: Insomniac's masterpiece: the best swinging since the 2004 tie-in, its own seriously told Peter Parker story — and proof that Marvel games can do AAA. Over 33 million copies sold (with sequels).
games.miles-morales: The compact standalone about Miles' first solo months — venom blasts, Harlem in the snow, and the best game translation of the Spider-Verse feeling.
games.spiderman2-ps: Both Spider-Men playable, Venom as a heavyweight, symbiote arc — essentially the game version of Sony's movie dreams, only executed better.
games.wolverine-game: Insomniac's next project: a mature Wolverine solo. Silent since the 2021 announcement — expectations are huge anyway.
games.rivals: The free-to-play hero shooter (6v6) with a huge roster from Doom to Jeff the Land Shark — currently THE Marvel game of the moment, with Doomsday synergies in the marketing.
games.midnight-suns: Tactics-card hybrid from the XCOM makers with the supernatural corner: Ghost Rider, Blade, Scarlet Witch. Underrated — and thematically the best Mephisto/Darkhold deep-dive outside the series.
games.gotg-game: Eidos' story single-player: its own tone, great team banter, an 80s soundtrack — the hidden gem among Marvel games.
games.avengers-game: The live-service experiment with a strong Kamala campaign and a weak endgame — officially shut down in 2023. A cautionary tale that shaped the industry.
games.snap: The card game from the creator of Hearthstone: three-minute matches, locations from all over the multiverse — perfect for your pocket.
games.lego-marvel: The family classic: hundreds of characters, Stan Lee collection missions (!) and more Marvel deep cuts than some films. Three main entries plus an Avengers spin-off.
games.ua3: Couch co-op brawler along the Infinity Saga — simple, but with friends exactly right.
games.xmow-game: The rare tie-in that is better than its film: brutal, bloody, with honest berserker feeling. Cult.
games.spiderman2-2004: The tie-in that invented open-world swinging — its physics system was the reference for two decades, until Insomniac took over.
games.deadpool-game: High Moon's fourth-wall massacre with Nolan North — three years before the film it proved Deadpool works R-rated.
games.mvc: The legendary crossover fighting series ('MAHVEL BABY!') — a whole generation's first contact with the Marvel roster.
games.marvel1943: Amy Hennig's (Uncharted) story game: Captain America and Azzuri — the Black Panther of World War II — against Hydra. A cinematic heavyweight in the works.
games.blade-game: Arkane Lyon (Dishonored) takes on the Daywalker — announced in 2023, in the coffin of patience ever since. Fitting for the film's holding pattern.
